g.text: The window: made where it was left, followed, and kept in window.json
and, if damaged, backed it up and made it anew)
can_create_surfaces: the monitors can be listed now
RestorePlan { size, position, maximized, fullscreen, zoom }:
the saved place if the window would be visible there,
else centred on its monitor or the primary one
creation theme: none on Windows)); can_create_surfaces
the viewport at zoom 1, with the window's theme
as saved: only now, since a window manager
ignores a maximize asked of a hidden window
Keeper::new(saved); changed(now): the first reading is
due in 500 ms, as no event need report the first size
changed(now): no reading, no write on the resize path
first change + 3 s): a long drag
is saved at least every 3 s
at due: read the window (size, frame's corner,
surface's corner, maximized, full screen, monitor)
change only while neither maximized nor full screen
save_with: write_atomic, only if the state changed
follow_zoom: a zoom out of [0.25, 5] set back (L15)
set_zoom: to hundredths; saved when due
full_screen_changed: "Press F11 to leave full screen"
read it now, for the last time
forward: Blitz drops the view (the chrome saves
the session and history), and the loop exits
Drop: the last reading, if still unwritten
A process that is killed loses at most the
changes of the last 500 ms (3 s during a drag).
